item.title: Pakistan
item.description: Pakistan has one of the highest malnutrition burdens in the world. Stunting, wasting and micronutrient deficiencies are endemic. The National Nutrition Survey 2018 revealed that 42.6% of women of reproductive age were anemic, 46.9% of pregnant women were iron deficient, 81.2% of pregnant women and 62.7% of children were vitamin D deficient. The same survey reported that 40.2% of children under five were stunted, 17.7% were wasted and 9.5% were overweight.

item.title: Why Nutrition Starts Long Before the Plate
item.description: When we think about improving nutrition, our minds often jump to the dinner plate: the colourful vegetables, the lean proteins, the whole grains. We focus on consumer choices, dietary guidelines, and the individual responsibility to eat healthily. But what if the most critical decisions shaping our nutrition have already been made long before the food reaches our plate? What if the very food environments where we buy our food are the true starting point for a healthy diet?
